metadata.title: Post a task | Slashie
metadata.description: Post a Slashie task with details, timing, budget, contact preference, and location.

en.title: Tell workers what you need
en.description: Add the details, timing, budget, and location so nearby workers can send useful quotes.
en.missingDetails: Some details are missing - check earlier steps.
en.prohibitedBody: Do not post illegal, unsafe, or licensed work unless the worker holds the right credentials. Slashie does not vet listings.
en.prohibitedConfirm: I confirm this task is legal, and I will not ask for unsafe or unlicensed work.
en.prohibitedRequired: Confirm this task is allowed before publishing.

location.searchPlaceholder: Search a street, area, or postcode
location.locateUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Search or drag the map instead.
location.privacyCallout: Your exact address stays private until you accept a worker. Until then, workers only see an approximate area on the map.
location.areaLabel: Approximate area, shown on the map
location.areaPending: Move the map to set the area.
location.addressHelper: Shared only with the worker you accept, after you hire them.

metadata.title: 發佈任務 | Slashie
metadata.description: 在 Slashie 發佈任務，加入詳情、時間、預算、聯絡偏好和地點。

zh_hk.title: 告訴 workers 你需要甚麼
zh_hk.description: 加入詳情、時間、預算和地點，讓附近 workers 傳送有用報價。
zh_hk.missingDetails: 部分資料未完成，請檢查前面的步驟。
zh_hk.prohibitedBody: 請勿發布非法、不安全的工作，或在對方沒有所需資格時要求持牌工作。Slashie 不會審查刊登內容。
zh_hk.prohibitedConfirm: 我確認此任務合法，且不會要求不安全或無牌的工作。
zh_hk.prohibitedRequired: 發布前請確認此任務屬於允許範圍。

location.searchPlaceholder: 搜尋街道、地區或郵遞區號
location.locateUnavailable: 無法取得你的位置，請搜尋或拖動地圖。
location.privacyCallout: 你接受工作者之前，你的確實地址會保密。在此之前，工作者只會在地圖上看到大概地區。
location.areaLabel: 大概地區，會顯示在地圖上
location.addressHelper: 只會在你聘用工作者後，分享給你接受的工作者。
